name: Nemesis
impact: Interrupt timing side-channel leaks instruction-granular execution state from enclaves (Intel SGX, Sancus, TrustLite)
mitigation: Constant-time interrupt handling; microcode redesign of interrupt latency
boundary_statement: Nemesis (CCS 2018) abuses CPU interrupt mechanism to leak microarchitectural instruction timings from enclaves (Intel SGX, Sancus, TrustLite). It does not affect Intel TDX or AMD SEV-SNP. No assigned CVE; mitigated via constant-time interrupt handling.

INTENT.evidence: Abstract: 'leak microarchitectural instruction timings from enclaved execution environments such as Intel SGX, Sancus, and TrustLite.' No SEV-SNP or TDX mention; predates TDX (2018).
